facts.text: Welcome earned its name when a 1900s meeting decided the new Winston‑Salem Southbound Railway depot should be called Welcome, and everyone agreed it was the most welcoming name.
The town’s motto, “Welcome to Welcome, A Friendly Place,” proudly hangs on the local welcome sign.
Local radio waves buzz with WUNW‑FM, a community station that broadcasts at 91.1 FM right here in Welcome.
Welcome is the birthplace of Richard Childress Racing, the NASCAR team that has competed at the highest level for decades.
The area’s historic cemeteries—Beulah Church of Christ, Good Hope Methodist, and Waggoner Graveyard—are all listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
Three schools serve the town: Welcome Elementary, North Davidson Middle, and North Davidson High School, all located within the community’s borders.
